chapters.title: Decay Without Overflow
chapters.blurb: Kimi Delta Attention bounds log-decay so recurrent state can cross long sequences while every causal tile uses dense Tensor Core computation.

chapters.title: Every Layer Can Look Back
chapters.blurb: Attention Residuals let each layer retrieve earlier representations, then reduce live state by attending over block summaries instead of every layer output.

chapters.title: Sixteen Experts, No Stampede
chapters.blurb: Stable LatentMoE routes each token through sixteen of eight hundred ninety-six experts in a compact latent space, with bounded activations and quantile-balanced dispatch.

chapters.title: Keep the Agent's World Alive
chapters.blurb: Million-token reinforcement learning preserves prefixes and sandbox state across partial rollouts with external cache pooling, resumable micro virtual machines, and hybrid prefix checkpoints.
